# `app/vendor/` — vendored front-end dependencies

Everything the UI in `app/` needs from third parties is committed here and served
from the same origin as the app, so the add-on UI works on a LAN without
internet access. These files are third-party or generated output: ESLint ignores
this directory (`eslint.config.js`) and the Tailwind build does not scan it
(`tailwind.source.css` uses `source(none)` with explicit `@source` globs).

| File | Version | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tailwind.css` | tailwindcss 4.3.3 (banner in the file) | generated by `npm run build:css` from `tailwind.source.css`; CI fails when it is stale |
| `chart.umd.js` | chart.js 4.5.1 | the official `dist/chart.umd.min.js` of npm `chart.js@4.5.1`, byte-identical |
| `patternomaly.min.js` | patternomaly 1.3.2 (final release) | jsDelivr's minified `patternomaly@1.3.2/dist/patternomaly.js` |
| `fonts.css`, `fonts/*.woff2` | Outfit v15, JetBrains Mono v24 | Google Fonts, `latin` and `latin-ext` subsets only; the non-Mac variants (what a Windows or Linux Chrome user agent gets), with the `src` URLs rewritten to `./fonts/` |

## Licenses

The add-on image and this public repository redistribute these files, so their
upstream license texts travel with them in `licenses/`:

| Vendored file | License | Notice file |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tailwind.css` | MIT | `licenses/tailwindcss.LICENSE.txt` |
| `chart.umd.js` | MIT | `licenses/chartjs.LICENSE.md` |
| `patternomaly.min.js` | MIT | `licenses/patternomaly.LICENSE.txt` |
| `fonts/outfit-*.woff2` | OFL-1.1 | `licenses/outfit.OFL.txt` |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | OFL-1.1 | `licenses/jetbrains-mono.OFL.txt` |

When you bump a vendored file, update its row above and refresh its notice file
from the matching upstream tag in the same commit.

The solver binaries (`vendor/highs-build/` at the repo root) carry their own
`LICENSE` and `PROVENANCE.md`.
